Cover each scene. The script is what happens; you decide the camera setups in this director's style, and place every spoken line in the shot it is spoken in. Copy sceneNumber from the "## Scene N" headings.

<DIRECTOR_STYLE>
Mood: Fresh, sensory, and effortlessly cool
Camera: Dynamic mix of handheld and locked shots with consistent energy. Handheld with natural micro-movement for lifestyle moments -- hands interacting, daily rituals, real context. Quick-cut to locked beauty frames for hero product shots. Macro details on textures and surfaces. Overhead flat-lays directly above. Eye-level and slightly above angles. Shallow depth of field on tactile details. Energetic pacing -- no lingering, every frame earns its time
References: modern social-first skincare-brand content; dewy minimalist beauty-brand visual identity; sun-soaked lifestyle beauty campaigns; playful color-blocked skincare content
</DIRECTOR_STYLE>

<CHARACTERS>
- Scarlett
- Barista
- Photographer
</CHARACTERS>

<SCENES>
## Scene 1 — DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM
INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — MORNING
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 1 — 6s

INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — MORNING

Hard morning light cuts across white tile and a black stone sink. Scarlett, late twenties, black turtleneck, reaches into an open coral carton while her phone buzzes beside a cold coffee. She ignores the phone, lifts the lipstick, and turns it in her fingers as the camera makes a quick handheld drift toward the vivid coral tube.

---

## Scene 2 — DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM
INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — CONTINUOUS
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 2 — 6s

INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — CONTINUOUS

Scarlett twists the coral bullet upward with one decisive click. The faceted tip catches a stripe of sunlight; her thumb grazes the smooth metal casing. Cut to her reflection as she applies one clean sweep to her lower lip, then presses her lips together and gives herself a testing half-smile.

---

## Scene 3 — DOWNTOWN APARTMENT — ENTRYWAY
INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT — ENTRYWAY — MORNING
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 3 — 6s

INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT — ENTRYWAY — MORNING

Scarlett crosses the narrow apartment in one fluid rush, sliding black sunglasses into her hair and grabbing a canvas tote from a chair. She checks the lipstick in the small mirror by the door, dabs the corner of her mouth with her pinky, and says, “Good. Let’s go.” The camera tracks backward as she pulls the door open into bright city light.

---

## Scene 4 — DOWNTOWN SIDEWALK
EXT. DOWNTOWN SIDEWALK — MORNING
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 4 — 6s

EXT. DOWNTOWN SIDEWALK — MORNING

A courier bicycle glides past the lens as Scarlett steps into a crowded sidewalk stream. She dodges a newspaper box, swings her tote against her hip, and the coral on her mouth flashes against her black collar. The camera moves alongside her with lively handheld micro-shake, glass towers sliding behind.

---

## Scene 5 — DOWNTOWN CROSSWALK
EXT. DOWNTOWN CROSSWALK — MORNING
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 5 — 6s

EXT. DOWNTOWN CROSSWALK — MORNING

At the red light, Scarlett leans toward a shop window and catches her reflection among mannequins and passing shoulders. The signal changes; the crowd surges forward around her. She starts across with them, turning her face briefly toward the camera as sunlight snaps across the coral shade.

---

## Scene 6 — CORNER COFFEE SHOP
INT. CORNER COFFEE SHOP — LATE MORNING
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 6 — 6s

INT. CORNER COFFEE SHOP — LATE MORNING

Scarlett sets her phone, keys, and lipstick on a tiny marble counter while a barista pushes an iced coffee toward her. She wraps one hand around the sweating cup, takes a sip, and checks the lipstick in the dark screen of her phone. A quick rack focus shifts from the coral tube to her satisfied grin.

---

## Scene 7 — CITY NEWSSTAND — NOON
EXT. CITY NEWSSTAND — NOON
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 7 — 6s

EXT. CITY NEWSSTAND — NOON

Wind flips the corners of newspapers as Scarlett reaches over a rack to buy a small bunch of coral ranunculus from a flower bucket. She tucks the stems beneath her arm, the petals echoing her lipstick. A bus rolls through the background, briefly washing the frame with reflected red and cream light.

---

## Scene 8 — LOFT STUDIO — AFTERNOON
INT. LOFT STUDIO — AFTERNOON
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 8 — 6s

INT. LOFT STUDIO — AFTERNOON

In a sunlit loft, Scarlett leans over a long table scattered with fabric swatches, camera cards, and a half-eaten orange. She uncaps the lipstick and refreshes the center of her lower lip without looking in a mirror, then snaps the cap shut as a photographer’s hand gestures from behind camera. She laughs and says, “Still here.”
